title: [Mar] Quick Hits — Conferences**: Mobile World Congress 2026 (Barcelona, 2-5 March, theme "The IQ Era", India rep Jyotiraditya Scindia); 11th Raisina Dialogue (New Delhi, 5-7 March, Chief Guest Finland's President Alexander Stubb, theme "Saṁskāra"); BRICS CCI Women Empowerment Summit (6th edn, New Delhi, 21-23 March, theme WISE, Shabana Azmi honoured); Global Conference on Women in Agri-Food Systems 2026 (inaugurated by President Murmu; UN's 2026 = Intl Year of the Woman Farmer); 9th India Pharma Conference 2026 (13-14 April, theme "Discover in India"); Prakriti 2026 Carbon Markets Conference (3 pillars: Credibility, Capital, Collaboration — Paris Agreement Article 6); Bharat Tex 2026 (3rd edn, 14-17 July, "5F Vision").
